guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：可重現軟體建置
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Reproducible software builds
guides.concept: 以確定輸入、位元重現與差異診斷連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect defined inputs, byte reproducibility and difference diagnosis through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「重現定義」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同程式行為不等於相同位元。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較語義與位元驗收。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「建置規格」的資料、控制與時間關係。環境資訊需足以重建而非只說明 OS。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立最小可重現環境表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「路徑汙染」的資料、控制與時間關係。絕對路徑可能嵌入除錯資訊。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較兩個假想工作根目錄。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「亂數種子」的資料、控制與時間關係。固定種子需涵蓋實際亂數來源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出沒有固定的 generator。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「獨立建置」的資料、控制與時間關係。獨立環境增加對非確定性檢驗。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較兩環境原始摘要。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「證據邊界」的資料、控制與時間關係。重現不能證明原始碼沒有惡意。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分開內容審查與位元證據。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for reproduction definition. Equivalent behavior differs from byte identity. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare semantic and byte acceptance. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for build specifications. Environment records must enable rebuilding, not just name an OS. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build a minimal reproduction environment table. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for path contamination. Absolute paths may enter debug information. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare two modeled workspace roots. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for random seeds. Seeds must cover actual randomness sources. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List unpinned generators. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for independent builds. Independent environments test nondeterminism. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare raw digests across two environments. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for evidence boundaries. Reproducibility does not prove benign source code. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate source review and byte evidence. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「雜湊時間」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「重算本課 0.5 s 模型。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「證據邊界」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「重現不能證明原始碼沒有惡意。」。
提交「證據邊界」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分開內容審查與位元證據。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit hashing time input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit evidence boundaries two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit evidence boundaries input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：相同原始碼即可忽略工具鏈和時間差異。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Identical source makes toolchain/time differences irrelevant. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

courses.overview: 由確定輸入、位元重現與差異診斷延伸；共用概念不代表可原封不動搬移全部規格或程式。
courses.overviewEn: Extend defined inputs, byte reproducibility and difference diagnosis; shared concepts do not imply unchanged specifications or code.

related.title: 持續整合與交付管線
related.why: 版本與產物摘要可串接 CI 證據
related.transfer: 版本與產物摘要可串接 CI 證據
related.difference: 可重現要求跨建置位元一致，CI 可只有單次測試
related.differenceEn: Reproduction needs byte equality across builds; CI may test once
practice: 由「重現定義」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「可重現要求跨建置位元一致，CI 可只有單次測試」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From reproduction definition, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Reproduction needs byte equality across builds; CI may test once", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
